name: expense-exports
description: Explain why Brex says exported when expenses are missing from QuickBooks or another ERP. Use batch history, downloaded CSV, ERP rows, required GL fields and export-type changes. Use pasted accounting records to reconcile missing ERP entries and identify preparation or export blockers. Includes a delivery workpaper and a field-by-field correction plan.
